subject: Support the legacy `struct termio` TTY and PTY ioctls
notes:
One commit on top of base e8f2b9ca6, 6 files, +131/-10. make format exited 0 and changed nothing (numstat identical before and after), then make check exited 0 twice with no warnings beyond the pre-existing benign rustup 'default toolchain implicitly overridden' notice; no lint fix was needed, so no fix round was spent.

One file was added beyond fix.json's changed_files: the SCML coverage file. Both prior tty-ioctl commits in the log (162bc5eb7 TCGETS2/TCSETS2, 4e05a89e2 TCSETSW2/TCSETSF2) edit book/.../file-descriptor-and-io-control/ioctl.scml in the same commit as the kernel change and say so in the message, so documenting newly supported ioctl commands there is repo convention for exactly this kind of change. Added TCGETA | TCSETA | TCSETAW | TCSETAF to tty_ops in Linux numeric order (between the TCSETSF and TCGETS2 entries, mirroring the ordering the patch uses in ioctl_defs.rs) and reflowed the continuation lines to the file's existing width; the +4/-4 is that one logical addition. Verified rather than assumed: make check does not cover SCML (AGENTS.md:92 lists it separately and it has its own workflow, .github/workflows/validate_scmls.yml), so I ran that workflow's exact command -- tools/sctrace.sh over every book/src/kernel/linux-compatibility/**/*.scml with `-- echo Asterinas` -- and it exited 0. sctrace hardcodes no ioctl op names (grep for TCGETS2, already present in the file, returns zero hits in tools/sctrace/), so the four legacy names parse as ordinary tokens.

Commit message: subject is imperative and names the kernel change, not the test. Body gives the root cause (the family absent from ioctl_defs.rs, so 0x5405 reaches a default ENOTTY arm before the argument is touched, masking the EFAULT the copy-out would raise), then diagnose.json's invariant and its ENOTTY-is-not-a-substitute-for-a-fault consequence, then the owning_layer / fix.json layer -- the shared Tty::ioctl plus tty/termio.rs and tty/ioctl_defs.rs, above any TtyDriver and above the pty master/slave split, naming all four drivers that gain the family and why PtyMaster was the wrong home -- so a reviewer can judge placement, not just the edit. linux_reference is cited as the reason the behavior is right (tty_mode_ioctl handling TCGETA in the same switch as TCGETS over one struct ktermios, converting only at the copy boundary and returning -EFAULT there), which is also what justifies the low-16-bits/first-eight-c_cc merge. Closing line records the SCML doc edit and the enabled ioctl01. Body wrapped at <=76 columns, the dominant convention in the log (114 of 141 non-blank body lines in the last 120 commits are <=80). gvisor_filter is null, so no partial-blocklist note applies.

Staging was path-by-path, never `git add -A`. git diff --cached listed exactly the six paths and `git diff --numstat` was empty afterwards, so nothing was left half-staged. Confirmed `git diff e8f2b9ca6 HEAD -- kernel/ test/` is byte-identical to patch.diff apart from index lines, i.e. the commit's kernel and pool content is exactly what verify.json booted green -- the SCML file is the only content not covered by that comparison. No repro file exists in test/initramfs/src/regression/ (the commit touches 0 paths there; only pre-existing tracked dirs are present) and the scratch commit-message file was kept in /tmp.

git status is clean apart from the untracked .osdk/ build directory, which is the OSDK toolchain's own output rather than anything this run authored -- verify.json already recorded it as the only untracked path, and it was present before this phase.

Not pushed, no PR opened, nothing amended. Artifacts: /tmp/commit-zPiQPw-check.log (make check), /tmp/commit-zPiQPw-committed.diff (committed diff used for the patch.diff comparison), /tmp/commit-zPiQPw-msg.txt (commit message).
